summary: PN Smart Energy Ltd filed Form 6-K disclosing audited financial statements of Nanjing Cesun Power Co., Ltd. and unaudited pro forma combined financials related to its previously announced acquisition. The Company acquired a 56.0% equity interest in Nanjing Cesun for total consideration of approximately US$20.2 million, which closed on June 30, 2026, making Nanjing Cesun a wholly-owned subsidiary. No board recommendation or advisors were named. Pro forma statements are illustrative only. The acquisition was disclosed via a foreign private issuer report, the US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K. Watch for integration execution and future financial reporting of combined operations.
